translations.web: “Am I a God at hand,” says Yahweh, “and not a God afar off?
translations.bsb: “Am I only a God nearby,” declares the LORD, “and not a God far away?”
translations.kjv: Am I a God at hand, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?
